tournaments.listIntro: Leagues and players organize tournaments. You play in AoE2 at the scheduled time and the result enters the bracket on its own, read from the game history.
tournaments.bracketNote: You play in AoE2, in a {size} lobby. After the agreed time, the portal looks for the match between the two teams in the game history and advances the winner by itself.

next.title: Your next match · {round}
next.step1: Agree on a time with your opponent and create a {size} lobby in the game.
next.step2: Just play. No screenshot or report needed.
next.step3: The result shows up here on the next sync.

formatHints.single_elim: Single elimination from the first round.
formatHints.groups_elim: Round-robin groups; the best of each group go to the knockout.
formatHints.swiss_elim: Everyone plays every round and winners face winners, with no rematches. The best of the final table go to the knockout.

new.swissPlayAll: Play every game of the series
new.swissPlayAllHint: The series only closes after every game, even if a team already has the majority. Winning the series is worth 1 point; the map score is a tiebreaker.

swiss.title: Swiss stage
swiss.nextPlayAll: {n} games, all played; the series is worth 1 point
swiss.intro: {rounds} rounds: winners face winners, with no rematches. Winning a series is worth 1 point. After the last round, the top {adv} go to the knockout: the best placed team faces the lowest qualifier, and so on.
swiss.tiebreak: Tiebreak: head-to-head among tied teams, MB (Median-Buchholz: opponents' points without the best and the worst), map difference.

col.mbTitle: Median-Buchholz: opponents' points, without the best and the worst

plan.title: Set up round {n}
plan.hint: Site suggestion: teams with the same points, no rematches. If your official table is different, change the teams before creating.

swiss.undoRoundHint: Deletes this round's matches. Only shown while none of its games has been recorded.
swiss.startHint: Set up round 1 in the Swiss stage. After that no more teams can join.
swiss.bracketLater: The bracket becomes available after round {total}.

err.round_open: The current round still has open matches.
err.rounds_done: All Swiss rounds have already been created.
err.pairs: Each confirmed team must appear exactly once in the pairings.
